Reporting now. Everything below is already verified; both inbox items are filed (I-0715 issue, I-0716 memory).

## Q2 (your priority) — VERDICT: legitimate. The `g = ![1]` route does NOT make "locally" vacuous.

Yes, `Localization.Away (1 : R)` is essentially `R`. That does not weaken the predicate, because of which side of the quantifier it sits on. `IsLocallyCertifiedAff` (`DivisorFamilyAffZar.lean:103`) is an **existential** over span-⊤ families `g : Fin m → R`. Discharging an ∃ at `m = 1, g = ![1]`, `Ideal.span {1} = ⊤` is a legitimate witness, not a weakening of the conclusion. The "locally" is a relaxation on the **input** side: it lets a weaker datum suffice than a global certificate. It does not make the conclusion say less than the name suggests, and a consumer that later needs a genuinely non-trivial cover still gets one from the per-prime form.

The chart-typed lane does exactly the same thing at `isLocallyCertified_of_isCertified` (`DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean:150`), so this is a faithful port, not a shortcut you invented. Your docstring at `DivisorFamilyAffSeedGate.lean:112-115` describes it correctly, including that the per-prime form remains needed when the degree datum only appears after shrinking the base. Nothing to fix.

## On your Q4 fix: the measurement is right, the pricing is WRONG

You asked me to speak only if I think your fix or your clause-3 argument is wrong. Your clause-3 argument is **right** — clause 3 governs the certificate clauses, and those are clean (I confirm no `FinCoverData`, no `ChartTyping`, and specifically no `relCover_sup`). Your calibrated-probe correction is right too.

But one sentence you added is false, and it carries the whole "cosmetic residue" verdict:

> "the widened route consumes it without ever needing the containment"

`hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀` **is** the containment, and it is a hypothesis of every declaration in both files. At a seed, `cover.opens z₀ = D.piece z₀` (`DivSchemeFamily.lean:351`, rfl) and `D.piece_le z₀ : D.piece z₀ ≤ relPinnedChart C R pi (D.side z₀)` (`:98`). Two probes, both `EXIT=0`:

- `/tmp/claude-1001/rev-probe/Chart.lean` — `hsub` + `hWle` alone give `supportLocus ⊆ relPinnedChart C R pi (D.side z₀)`. Proof: `fun w hw => D.piece_le z₀ (hWle (hsub hw))`.
- `/tmp/claude-1001/rev-probe/Straddle.lean` — if the support has a point off `V₀` and one off `V₁`, **no** tuple `(W, hW, hsub, z₀, hWle)` exists.

So the gate's hypothesis set is *empty* for every straddling divisor — which is precisely the class `DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean:186` uses to prove the widening strict, and it does so at a **bare** `LocalEquations` with unconstrained cover. Your gate is that theorem restated at a seed, and the restatement voids it. Clause 3 is intact; **clause 5** ("no repair that keeps the pieces inside the preimages of a fixed pair of points of P¹") is about the route, and this route does.

This also sharpens your Q3 fix rather than contradicting it: the only inhabitation witness has *empty* support, and non-empty straddling supports are now **refuted**, not merely un-witnessed. The hypothesis set is inhabited only where the widening buys nothing.

Residue: either a chart-free seed notion (its `h` field typed at an arbitrary affine open rather than `relPinnedChart C R pi (side z)`), or a producer of `LocalEquations` from geometry that is not a `ThetaGeneratorSeed`.

## Q1, Q5, Q6 — all three claims survive

Q1: confirmed by declaration closure, not grep. At `a65bd79c6^` zero files in the tree mention both `ThetaGeneratorSeed` and `IsLocallyCertifiedAff`/`DivFamZarAff`, either direction. At HEAD an environment census finds 8 declarations whose type mentions both and 2 whose *value closure* reaches the seed — all of them yours.

Q5: genuine, not a rename. `(divFunctorAff C n).obj (op (overSpec k R))` is a real functor value (`map_id`/`map_comp` proved, `DivisorFamilyAffMap.lean:208,290`), and the identification lemma points the useful way (a consumer holding the section recovers the certificate's class). Your staleness claim holds: `divFamZarAff.map` exists at HEAD, so the caveat at `DivisorFamilyAffVehicle.lean:204-207` is stale.

Q6: scope docstrings and commit messages are honest. The one defect is the sentence quoted above — and it is in your newest commit, so it is live.

## Not verified

I did **not** examine `DivisorFamilyAffAwayRep.lean` / commit 745bcd90d, or your "step 1 contains no chart content, ports in four moves" split against `DivisorFamilyAffFraming.lean`. It arrived after my brief and I stopped when you called. Treat it as unreviewed — and note that the failure mode I found in the gate is the same shape as the one that split would hide, so it is worth the same test: instantiate step 1's hypotheses at the configuration `exists_certChartCover`'s two-chart window describes and try to derive False.

## Throughput note

Not churning — the work is real and the self-audit instinct in `20bb502ae` is the right one. The concern is that `divFunctorAffSection` and `divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen` have zero consumers outside their own files, and `DivRepGlobalAffLift.lean` (named as the consumer) mentions `divFunctorAff` only in prose. Combined with the finding above: a functorially correct bridge whose input side this project's only seed notion cannot feed.

11	# The R2 endpoint AT A SEED: one geometric input left
12	
13	`DivisorFamilyAffStraddle.lean` gave the widened endpoint
14	`exists_isCertified_of_swallowing_affineOpen`, whose three inputs were the Stacks `0B8B` datum,
15	the fibrewise-regularity datum `hfib` (protection I-0492 obligation 4(i)), and the rank datum
16	`hrank`.  Two of those three are now discharged rather than assumed:
17	
18	* `hfib` — by `ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` (`…AffFibre.lean`), from the
19	  seed's own clause, at every widened cover and every widened adaptation;
20	* `hrank` — reduced by `…AffRank.lean` from the glued module over an unknown finite cover to
21	  the colength of the ONE swallowing piece.
22	
23	This file composes them, so what a producer owes is visible in a single signature.  The point
24	of doing it here rather than leaving it to the reader is the lesson of run 0070 s0006: a
25	producer and a consumer can each be correct and still not compose (`AffAdaptation` needs
26	subordination, which bare containment does not give).  Composition is checked by the elaborator
27	below, not asserted in prose.
28	
29	## What is left, and it is ONE statement
30	
31	`exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen` takes:
32	
33	1. the **subordinate Stacks `0B8B` input** — an affine open `W ⊇ supp d` inside one member of
34	   `d.cover` (I-0492 clause 2: USE, do not re-derive; mathlib has no `0B8B` and this tree
35	   constructs no curve but `P¹`);
36	2. the **degree datum at `W`** — the colength of the swallowing piece has constant fibre rank
37	   `n`.  This is "the divisor has degree `n`", read where the divisor actually is.
38	
39	and returns a widened cover, an adaptation, and **all seven** certificate clauses.  No
40	`|P¹(k)|` hypothesis appears anywhere in the chain, which is the whole purpose of R2.
41	
42	## Main declarations
43	
44	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen` — the endpoint.
45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen_of_rank_glued` — the
46	  same with the rank datum in its original glued form, for a consumer that already has it.
47	-/
48	
49	set_option autoImplicit false
50	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
51	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

54	
55	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite TensorProduct
56	
57	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
58	
59	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
60	
61	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
62	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
63	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] {a : Nat}
64	variable {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
65	
66	/-- **The R2 endpoint at a theta-generator seed, with the rank datum on the swallowing piece.**
67	
68	The two obligations protection I-0492 clause 4 relocated are now in different states, and the
69	signature says which is which:
70	
71	* obligation 4(i), fibrewise-finite support, is **discharged** — it does not appear, because
72	  `ThetaGeneratorSeed.affAdaptation_fibre_regular` supplies it from the seed;
73	* the Stacks `0B8B` input is **assumed**, per clause 2, in its subordinate form (`hWle`);
74	* the degree datum is assumed at the swallowing piece, which is where a degree statement lives.
75	
76	`hproj` is the (c1)-projectivity the assembler already needed, and it now follows from the
77	discharged fibrewise datum — so it is derived here too, not assumed. -/
78	theorem exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen [IsProper C.hom]
79	    [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : ℕ} {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
80	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
81	    (hsub : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
82	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀)
83	    (hrank : ∀ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD))
84	      (j₀ : Dc.index),
85	      (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (Dc.pieces j₀ : Set (relCurve C R)) →
86	      (∀ j : Dc.index, j ≠ j₀ →
87	        Disjoint (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus (Dc.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) →
88	      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (A.colength j₀) p = n) :
89	    ∃ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)),
90	      A.IsCertified n := by
91	  classical
92	  obtain ⟨Dc, A, hsw⟩ :=
93	    exists_affAdaptation_swallowedBy C R (D.localEquations hD) hW hsub z₀ hWle
94	  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀sub, hj₀miss⟩ := hsw
95	  -- (c1)-finiteness from the straddling shape
96	  haveI hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j) :=
97	    A.forall_finite_colength_of_swallowedBy ⟨j₀, hj₀sub, hj₀miss⟩
98	  -- (c1)-projectivity from the DISCHARGED fibrewise datum, not from a hypothesis
99	  have hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := fun j => by
100	    haveI := hfin j
101	    exact A.projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField j
102	      (fun p => D.affAdaptation_fibre_regular hD Dc A j p)
103	  exact ⟨Dc, A, A.isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1_of_rank_piece hj₀sub hj₀miss hfin hproj
104	    (hrank Dc A j₀ hj₀sub hj₀miss)⟩
105	
106	/-- **The same endpoint with the rank datum in its glued form**, for a consumer that already
107	has `hrank` about `Glued` (e.g. one carrying it through a base change, where
108	`rankAtStalk_glued_pullback` is stated on the glued module).
109	
110	Kept as a separate statement rather than as the primary one: the glued form quantifies over a
111	cover the producer does not choose, and the one-piece form is what the geometry supplies. -/
112	theorem exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen_of_rank_glued [IsProper C.hom]
113	    [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : ℕ} {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
114	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
115	    (hsub : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ⊆ (W : Set (relCurve C R)))
116	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀)
117	    (hrank : ∀ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD))
118	      (p : PrimeSpectrum R), Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) A.Glued p = n) :
119	    ∃ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)),
120	      A.IsCertified n :=
121	  exists_isCertified_of_swallowing_affineOpen C R (D.localEquations hD) hW hsub z₀ hWle
122	    (fun Dc A j p => D.affAdaptation_fibre_regular hD Dc A j p) hrank
123	
124	/-! ## Non-vacuity of the endpoint
125	
126	Trap (c) of the workspace axiom-probe catalogue (`I-0442`): a theorem whose hypotheses cannot
127	be jointly satisfied is vacuously true and reports clean axioms like any other.  The endpoint
128	above has five hypotheses, and a clean `#print axioms` says nothing about whether they can hold
129	together.  So the joint inhabitation is exhibited rather than assumed. -/
130	
131	/-- **The endpoint's hypothesis set is jointly inhabited**, at the zero divisor with `n = 0`:
132	the support locus is empty, so the `0B8B` containment holds for ANY affine open inside a cover
133	member, and every colength vanishes so the degree datum holds at `n = 0`.
134	
135	This does not make the endpoint useful at the zero divisor — it certifies that the five
136	hypotheses are simultaneously satisfiable, so the theorem is not about nothing.
137	
138	**The exact strength of this witness, stated so nobody over-reads it.**  It inhabits the
139	hypothesis set at `n = 0`, i.e. at the DEGENERATE value of the index.  That rules out the
140	failure mode where the hypotheses contradict each other outright, and it does not rule out the
141	weaker-but-real possibility that they are satisfiable *only* at `n = 0`.  What is known about
142	`n > 0`: the endpoint fires whenever the degree datum is supplied at that `n` — nothing in the
143	hypothesis set forces `n = 0`, checked by elaborating the general instantiation — but supplying
144	that datum from geometry at a specific `n > 0` is the seed layer's business, not this file's.
145	So read this as "not self-contradictory", not as "non-trivially inhabited". Cf. inbox `I-0596`,
146	which records a sibling lane shipping a trivial-witness refutation that did not rule out
147	vacuity where it mattered. -/
148	theorem exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_supportLocus_empty [IsProper C.hom] [IsNoetherianRing R]
149	    {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
150	    (hempty : (D.localEquations hD).supportLocus = (∅ : Set (relCurve C R)))
151	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
152	    (z₀ : relCurve C R) (hWle : W ≤ (D.localEquations hD).cover.opens z₀) :
153	    ∃ (Dc : AffCoverData C R) (A : AffAdaptation Dc (D.localEquations hD)),
154	      A.IsCertified 0 :=
155	  exists_isCertified_of_seed_of_swallowing_affineOpen C R hD hW
156	    (by rw [hempty]; exact Set.empty_subset _) z₀ hWle
157	    (fun _ A _ _ _ p => A.rankAtStalk_colength_eq_zero_of_supportLocus_empty hempty _ p)

75:    [Algebra k R] (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π] (a : ℕ)
